description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'DittoBsonJson' that handles conversion between BSON and JSON, specifically for a MongoDB context. It replaces dots and dollar signs in JSON keys with unicode representations during parsing, and reverts these replacements during serialization, ensuring compatibility with MongoDB constraints.
